name: EUR/USD Crossover vs Crossunder Breakout Analysis
description: Compares crossover (close above) and crossunder (close below) behavior at three EUR/USD levels (1.05, 1.10, 1.15) to test whether these levels act as magnet/mean-reversion points in both directions. For each level and direction, detects events, computes 20-day forward returns, and compares event counts, average returns, and hit rates side by side. Includes a crossunder forward return histogram, price chart with all three reference levels, and clickable event markers for both crossover and crossunder events per level.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD CROSSOVER vs CROSSUNDER BREAKOUT ANALYSIS (1.05 / 1.10 / 1.15)
# =============================================================================
# Tests three levels in BOTH directions:
#   Crossover  = EUR/USD daily close crosses ABOVE level from below
#   Crossunder = EUR/USD daily close crosses BELOW level from above
# Forward window: 20 trading days
# Goal: Determine if 1.10 (and other levels) act as magnet/mean-reversion
#        points in both directions.
# Output: 6-row comparison table (crossover vs crossunder per level),
#         crossunder return histogram, price chart, event markers
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# --- Forward Returns (shared across all levels) ---
fwd_20d = ((close << 20) - close) / close

# =============================================================================
# CROSSOVER (above) EVENTS
# =============================================================================

# Level 1.05
is_xover_105 = crossover(close, 1.05)
fwd_xover_105 = where(is_xover_105, fwd_20d)
hit_xover_105 = where(is_xover_105, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_xover_105 = where(is_xover_105, close)

# Level 1.10
is_xover_110 = crossover(close, 1.10)
fwd_xover_110 = where(is_xover_110, fwd_20d)
hit_xover_110 = where(is_xover_110, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_xover_110 = where(is_xover_110, close)

# Level 1.15
is_xover_115 = crossover(close, 1.15)
fwd_xover_115 = where(is_xover_115, fwd_20d)
hit_xover_115 = where(is_xover_115, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_xover_115 = where(is_xover_115, close)

# =============================================================================
# CROSSUNDER (below) EVENTS
# =============================================================================

# Level 1.05
is_xunder_105 = crossunder(close, 1.05)
fwd_xunder_105 = where(is_xunder_105, fwd_20d)
hit_xunder_105 = where(is_xunder_105, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_xunder_105 = where(is_xunder_105, close)

# Level 1.10
is_xunder_110 = crossunder(close, 1.10)
fwd_xunder_110 = where(is_xunder_110, fwd_20d)
hit_xunder_110 = where(is_xunder_110, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_xunder_110 = where(is_xunder_110, close)

# Level 1.15
is_xunder_115 = crossunder(close, 1.15)
fwd_xunder_115 = where(is_xunder_115, fwd_20d)
hit_xunder_115 = where(is_xunder_115, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_xunder_115 = where(is_xunder_115, close)

# =============================================================================
# COMBINED CROSSUNDER RETURNS (for histogram)
# =============================================================================
fwd_xunder_all = coalesce(fwd_xunder_105, fwd_xunder_110, fwd_xunder_115)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Crossover vs Crossunder at Each Level ---
# 6 rows (crossover/crossunder × 3 levels) × 3 columns (events, avg return, hit rate)
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crossover vs Crossunder: +20d Forward Return Comparison',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=[
            '1.05 Crossover (Above)',
            '1.05 Crossunder (Below)',
            '1.10 Crossover (Above)',
            '1.10 Crossunder (Below)',
            '1.15 Crossover (Above)',
            '1.15 Crossunder (Below)'
        ],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg +20d Return', 'Hit Rate (+20d > 0)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: 1.05 Crossover
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Crossover events at 1.05'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after crossing above 1.05'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.05 crossovers with positive 20d return'),
            # Row 1: 1.05 Crossunder
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Crossunder events at 1.05'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after crossing below 1.05'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.05 crossunders with positive 20d return'),
            # Row 2: 1.10 Crossover
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Crossover events at 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after crossing above 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.10 crossovers with positive 20d return'),
            # Row 3: 1.10 Crossunder
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Crossunder events at 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after crossing below 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.10 crossunders with positive 20d return'),
            # Row 4: 1.15 Crossover
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Crossover events at 1.15'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after crossing above 1.15'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.15 crossovers with positive 20d return'),
            # Row 5: 1.15 Crossunder
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Crossunder events at 1.15'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after crossing below 1.15'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.15 crossunders with positive 20d return')
        ]
    ),
    category='EUR/USD Crossover vs Crossunder',
    order=0
)(fwd_xover_105, fwd_xover_105, hit_xover_105, fwd_xunder_105, fwd_xunder_105, hit_xunder_105, fwd_xover_110, fwd_xover_110, hit_xover_110, fwd_xunder_110, fwd_xunder_110, hit_xunder_110, fwd_xover_115, fwd_xover_115, hit_xover_115, fwd_xunder_115, fwd_xunder_115, hit_xunder_115)

# --- Histogram: Distribution of +20d Returns After Crossunder (All Levels) ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of +20d Returns After Crossunder (All Levels Combined)',
    category='EUR/USD Crossover vs Crossunder',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='20-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_xunder_all)

# --- Chart: EUR/USD Price with All Three Reference Levels ---
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Close with 1.05 / 1.10 / 1.15 Levels',
    category='EUR/USD Crossover vs Crossunder',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.05, title='1.05 Level', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.10, title='1.10 Level', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.15, title='1.15 Level', color=Color.Rose, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS — Crossover (Above)
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crossover Above 1.05',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_xover_105, close_xover_105, fwd_xover_105)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crossover Above 1.10',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_xover_110, close_xover_110, fwd_xover_110)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crossover Above 1.15',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_xover_115, close_xover_115, fwd_xover_115)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS — Crossunder (Below)
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crossunder Below 1.05',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_xunder_105, close_xunder_105, fwd_xunder_105)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crossunder Below 1.10',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_xunder_110, close_xunder_110, fwd_xunder_110)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crossunder Below 1.15',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_xunder_115, close_xunder_115, fwd_xunder_115)
